findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_templates, prepare_agent_vault, prepare_vault_page, post_agent_feedback, render_blockpage, render_blockpage_image · Private data: lookup_blockpage, post_agent_intro, prepare_agent_claim, prepare_agent_vault, check_vault_health, prepare_vault_page, post_agent_feedback · Public sink: verify_tip, post_agent_intro, prepare_agent_vault, prepare_vault_page, post_agent_feedback · Destructive: prepare_vault_page.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_templates, prepare_agent_vault, prepare_vault_page, post_agent_feedback, render_blockpage, render_blockpage_image · Private data: lookup_blockpage, post_agent_intro, prepare_agent_claim, prepare_agent_vault, check_vault_health, prepare_vault_page, post_agent_feedback · Public sink: verify_tip, post_agent_intro, prepare_agent_vault, prepare_vault_page, post_agent_feedback · Destructive: prepare_vault_page

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
